rationale: EO 11943 (Amendment of Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay and Allowances, signed October 25, 1976, 41 FR 47213) has one operative sentence: it orders that the adjusted maximum scale of pay in the Section 4103 Schedule for Director of Nursing Service, "as set forth in Schedule 3 of Executive Order No. 11941 of October 1, 1976, is amended by ehanging “ 2,611*” to read “ 52,611*”" (the held text reads "ehanging" for "changing"). That is a self-executing typographical correction completed on issue; the order carries no continuing duty of its own, and the corrected figure lives inside EO 11941. The first history observation, a Federal Register disposition note, reads "Amends: EO 11941, October 1, 1976 / Superseded by: EO 12010, September 28, 1977", and the second is the 1989 codification entry marking the order superseded by EO 12010. EO 12010 Sec. 4 reads "Executive Order No. 11941 of October 1, 1976, is superseded." and names only EO 11941, so the supersession reaches this order only through its parent, as the 5 U.S.C. 5332 note also records (EO 11941 "as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 11943 ... superseded by Ex. Ord. No. 12010"). Either way no part of EO 11943 can be in force on 2026-10-14: its own command was spent on 1976-10-25 and its surviving consequence ended with EO 11941. Status: no.
